description: The app's task-propose key (rc4-67): bound at POST /v1/device/token (worker.schema.json $defs/task_propose_key_bind, member task_propose_key) by bind_signature over "leanctx.cloud.task_propose_key_bind.v1\n" followed by canonical_json({alg, instance_public_key (the request's string), key_id, public_key, scope: "task_propose_person.v1"}); key_id = first 16 hex of sha256(raw public key). It then signs the person's own task proposals only: POST /v1/vaults/{pid}/tasks with origin.kind person carries signed_at (RFC 3339, within 600 s of the Cloud's clock) and task_signature over "leanctx.cloud.task_propose_person.v1\n" followed by canonical_json(body without task_signature, plus instance_id (the instance UUID, lower case with hyphens) and vault_id (32 lower-case hex digits without hyphens, whatever form {pid} used; any other form is refused)). The Cloud verifies it against this key only (never the presence key or the chat key); a chat-key bind of this key does not verify. Test keys only: task-propose key ed25519 seed = sha256("leanctx-cloud test task-propose key: rc4-67"); instance_public_key = standard base64 of the ed25519 public key of seed sha256("leanctx-cloud test instance key: rc4-67").
